items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Walter Page had played a bass line, and I took that bass line, which is basic blues bass line, and I put some notes in between notes

ctx.x: Walter Page had played a bass line, and I took that bass line, which is basic blues bass line, and I put some notes in between notes, which is a concept that I have. If I was a bass teacher to teach young people to play the bass--jazz, there’s certain beats in jazz that are strong and the weaker beat should have the stronger note.
